resources.title: Custom App Object & Field Planning Worksheet
resources.description: A nouns-to-objects worksheet for deciding relationship shape (lookup, master-detail, or a junction object) before opening Object Manager -- pre-filled with Lesson 4-5's full warranty-claims data model (Warranty_Claim__c, Claim_Line_Item__c) as a worked reference, plus the decision rules for each relationship type.

resources.title: Lightning App Builder Page Planning Checklist
resources.description: Plan a Lightning page's type, component list, Dynamic Forms visibility rules, and compact layout fields on paper before dragging anything onto the canvas -- covers all three page types and the drag/drop/configure loop from Lesson 8.

resources.title: App Build Decision Log Template
resources.description: The same four-chapter decomposition (data model / interface / logic / delivery) this course used on Harborline Logistics and the Help Desk Ticket capstone, as a reusable fill-in template for any new app request -- forces every decision to trace back to a specific line in the original stakeholder ask.
